FIXED (2026-09-18): measured every baseline on page 1 (mutool stext, fonts dir set). Non-list lines matched Word within 0.06pt; each bullet line was 0.50pt short (15.50 vs Word's 16.00). Word sizes the line as marker ascent (Symbol 11.06pt) + text descent (Calibri 2.95pt) x 1.15 = 16.115 -> 16.0 on its grid; we took the larger of the two fonts' whole line heights (15.50). label_boosted_line_h now combines ascent and descent, and the first baseline drops by the marker's extra ascent as in Word (first bullet step 26.03 = ref 26.03).
